WITH cpi AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID" AS art_id,
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
), erf AS (
  SELECT sd."ART_link" AS art_id,
         AVG(CASE v.val WHEN 'High' THEN 10 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS erf
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'),
                             (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature'),
                             (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity'),
                             (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration'),
                             (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants')) v(val)
  GROUP BY sd."ART_link"
)
SELECT MAX(c.cpi * e.erf) AS max_avs
FROM cpi c JOIN erf e ON e.art_id = c.art_id

WITH r AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS")::int AS yr, "TEMPc" AS temp
  FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS") BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
), y AS (
  SELECT yr, AVG(temp) AS avg_temp FROM r GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT y.yr AS year,
       ROUND(y.avg_temp, 2) AS avg_temperature,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(r.temp - y.avg_temp) > 0 AND ABS(r.temp - y.avg_temp) <= 4) AS anomaly_count
FROM y JOIN r ON r.yr = y.yr
GROUP BY y.yr, y.avg_temp
ORDER BY y.yr

WITH hs AS (
  SELECT sd."ART_link" AS art_id, sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' AS hum_sens
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
), cur AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ca.art_exam) ca.art_exam AS art_id, e."RH"
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" ca
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = ca.case_exam
  ORDER BY ca.art_exam, ca.assess_date DESC NULLS LAST, e."readTS" DESC
)
SELECT a."ARTregID", a.art_title, a."MatKind", hs.hum_sens,
       CASE WHEN (hs.hum_sens = 'High' AND cur."RH" > 55) OR (hs.hum_sens = 'Medium' AND cur."RH" > 60)
            THEN 'Over Exposure' ELSE 'Within Limits' END AS exposure_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN hs ON hs.art_id = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN cur ON cur.art_id = a."ARTregID"
WHERE hs.hum_sens IN ('Medium', 'High')
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"
note: No 'secondary, more cautious' humidity threshold is defined in knowledge.md; used the Humidity Exposure Thresholds (High >55% RH, Medium >60% RH) against the latest reading in the artifact's showcase.

SELECT DISTINCT a."ARTregID", a.art_title, ra.risk_level, r."HIST_sign",
       (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric AS cultural_score
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "RiskAssessments" ra ON ra.art_concern = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
WHERE ra.risk_level IN ('High', 'Medium')
  AND r."HIST_sign" > 8
  AND (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric > 20

WITH cpi AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID" AS art_id, a."DYNASTY",
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  WHERE a."DYNASTY" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c."DYNASTY", c.cpi AS cpi_score, cm.budget_alloc, cm.budget_stat
FROM cpi c
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = c.art_id
JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = ca.case_exam
JOIN "ConservationAndMaintenance" cm ON cm.monitor_link = e.monitor_code
note: 'Generalized budget status' taken as ConservationAndMaintenance.budget_stat, budget allocation as budget_alloc; artifact linked to maintenance via ConditionAssessments -> showcase readings -> monitor_link.

WITH erf AS (
  SELECT sd."ART_link" AS art_id,
         AVG(CASE v.val WHEN 'High' THEN 10 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS erf
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'),
                             (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature'),
                             (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity'),
                             (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration'),
                             (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants')) v(val)
  GROUP BY sd."ART_link"
), highs AS (
  SELECT sd."ART_link" AS art_id,
         COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(f.k, f.v) FILTER (WHERE f.v = 'High'), '{}'::jsonb) AS high_sensitivities
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT i.key AS k, i.value AS v
    FROM jsonb_each(sd.env_handling_sensitivity) g
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(g.value) i
  ) f
  GROUP BY sd."ART_link"
)
SELECT a."ARTregID", a.art_title, e.erf AS erf_score, h.high_sensitivities
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN erf e ON e.art_id = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN highs h ON h.art_id = a."ARTregID"
WHERE e.erf > 4
ORDER BY e.erf DESC
note: ERF = average of the five 'environment' sensitivities (light, temperature, humidity, vibration, pollutants), nulls ignored; JSON lists every High field in the sensitivity profile.

WITH cpi AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID", a.art_title, a."DYNASTY",
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  WHERE a."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming', 'Qing')
)
SELECT "ARTregID", art_title, "DYNASTY", cpi AS cpi_score,
       CASE WHEN cpi > 7 THEN 'High Priority' WHEN cpi > 4 THEN 'Medium Priority' ELSE 'Low Priority' END AS priority_level
FROM cpi
ORDER BY cpi DESC NULLS LAST

WITH sens AS (
  SELECT sd."ART_link" AS art_id,
         AVG(CASE v.val WHEN 'High' THEN 10 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS erf,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.val = 'High') AS high_count
  FROM "SensitivityData" sd
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'),
                             (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature'),
                             (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity'),
                             (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration'),
                             (sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants')) v(val)
  GROUP BY sd."ART_link"
), cur AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ca.art_exam) ca.art_exam AS art_id, e."TEMPc", e."RH"
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" ca
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = ca.case_exam
  ORDER BY ca.art_exam, ca.assess_date DESC NULLS LAST, e."readTS" DESC
)
SELECT a."ARTregID", a.art_title, cur."TEMPc" AS current_temperature, cur."RH" AS current_humidity,
       COALESCE(s.high_count, 0) AS high_sensitivity_count,
       CASE WHEN (a."ageYears" * s.erf * POWER(cur."RH" - 50, 2) * cur."TEMPc") / 100000.0 > 5
                 AND COALESCE(s.high_count, 0) >= 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
LEFT JOIN sens s ON s.art_id = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN cur ON cur.art_id = a."ARTregID"
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"

SELECT DISTINCT case_link AS showcase_id
FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
WHERE case_link IS NOT NULL
  AND ("tempVar24" > 1 OR "RHvar" > 3)
ORDER BY case_link

WITH sc AS (
  SELECT s."caseID",
         ((CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'seal_state' = 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS issue_count,
         (s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric AS leak_rate
  FROM "Showcases" s
), sesr AS (
  SELECT sc."caseID", 10 - ((e."tempVar24" + e."RHvar" / 5.0 + sc.leak_rate) / 3.0) AS sesr
  FROM sc JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = sc."caseID"
)
SELECT DISTINCT sc."caseID"
FROM sc
LEFT JOIN sesr ON sesr."caseID" = sc."caseID"
WHERE sesr.sesr < 5 OR sc.issue_count >= 3
ORDER BY sc."caseID"
